g.text: UNHYGIENIX / A / NOTCHED CELL SECTIONS
CONCEPT 01 | UNVERIFIED COMPONENT FIT | BATTERY UNSELECTED
All dimensions mm. A3. Published outer dimensions are not verified bare-host geometry.
A-A / y = -5.0, looking toward +Y / speaker face and side duct
53.8 BODY
13.9 TOTAL
Height equation: H = 7.9 + measured host height
Host solid is a D51 x H6.0 reservation, not a bare-PCB model.
Host lower datum Z 7.00; solid starts Z 7.15.
0.15 axial gap each side; 0.30 nominal radial host clearance.
0.60 bezel; D44.30 aperture over published 43.76 active area.
Cell: Z1.40-5.40, 4.00 target; no selected part/tolerance.
Installed cell reservation: Z1.20-6.70, including growth/liners.
Speaker body Z1.95-4.85; reserved H2.90.
Cup top Z5.40; gasket H0.25; face plenum H0.50.
Outlet duct 2.4 x 0.7; cavity and grille not acoustically qualified.
Rear floor 1.00; dielectric liner H0.20; no pouch support loads.
B-B / x = 13.4, looking toward -X / LRA and battery zone
13.9 TOTAL
LRA body Z1.60-4.15; D8.0 x H2.55 nominal.
Full FPC reservation 9.2 x 14.2, tail directed inward.
Rigid 0.30 shoe bonds to rear/deck, separately from cell.
0.10 adhesive under LRA body is an assumed stack allowance.
Optional rear HR: external ghost only, zero internal allocation.
No optical window or HR sensor is silently fitted in the cell volume.
A: concave cell outline is a feasibility envelope only.
Supplier manufacturability/capacity is unknown.
No rectangular 48 x 46 mm pocket is assumed.
Section boundaries tessellated from CAD at 0.04 mm; dimensions are exact model parameters. Colors identify placeholder components.
